title: Progress
lede: What your studying adds up to: the days you studied, a streak that forgives rest days, your week against your goal, and what the studying produced. Every number is counted from real study, and each links to where it was earned.

level.title: Level
level.next_one: {{count, number}} more study day to level {{level, number}} ({{days, number}} days).
level.next_other: {{count, number}} more study days to level {{level, number}} ({{days, number}} days).
level.last: The last level: a thousand days of study.
level.how: A level is earned by days you studied, any day with a review, an answer, a workout or a recording. It never goes down.

streak.title: Streak and weekly goal
streak.current_one: A streak of {{count, number}} study day.
streak.current_other: A streak of {{count, number}} study days.
streak.keep: Not studied today yet: one review keeps it going.
streak.rest_one: Rest days left this week: {{count, number}} of {{total, number}}; a missed day uses one and keeps the streak.
streak.rest_other: Rest days left this week: {{count, number}} of {{total, number}}; a missed day uses one and keeps the streak.
streak.noRest: No rest days: a missed day ends the streak.

week.title: This week
week.bar: {{days, number}} of {{goal, number}} study days this week
week.inARow_one: Goal met {{count, number}} week in a row.
week.inARow_other: Goal met {{count, number}} weeks in a row.

settings.title: Change the goal and rest days
settings.note: Weeks start on Monday. A new goal counts for past weeks too.

calendar.title: A year of study
calendar.label_one: {{count, number}} study day in the last year
calendar.label_other: {{count, number}} study days in the last year

outcomes.title: What the studying produced
outcomes.lede: Read from your cards, answers and logs as they are now.
outcomes.longTerm: Cards in long-term memory (remembered for 21 days or more)
outcomes.ofLearning_one: {{count, number}} of {{learning, number}} card being learnt
outcomes.ofLearning_other: {{count, number}} of {{learning, number}} cards being learnt
outcomes.right: Answered right in the last 30 days

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.none: None yet: the first is a single day of study.

kinds.weeks_one: The weekly goal {{count, number}} week in a row
kinds.weeks_other: The weekly goal {{count, number}} weeks in a row

circles.title: Study with friends
circles.lede: A study circle is a few friends who keep each other going: each sees whether the others studied this week, their streaks and levels, and can cheer them on once a day. Nobody sees what anyone studies.

invited.title: You were invited to a study circle
invited.body: Pick the name the circle will see you by, then join.

circles.none: You are in no circle yet. Start one and send the link to a friend, or join one with its code.

privacy.title: What a circle sees
privacy.seen: The others see the name you give the circle, your study days this week against your goal, your streak, your level and the day you last studied.
privacy.notSeen: They never see what you study, your documents, your answers or your email.
privacy.together: There is no ranking: the circle's goal is that everyone meets their own week.

errors.notFound: No circle has that code. Check it with whoever sent it; a circle's owner can make a new one.

circles.nicknameNote: The name you go by in a circle is the only thing about your account the others see. Pick any name.

circle.lede_one: {{count, number}} member. Each sees the others' steadiness, never what they study.
circle.lede_other: {{count, number}} members. Each sees the others' steadiness, never what they study.

week.title: This week together
week.met_one: {{count, number}} of {{total, number}} met their weekly goal
week.met_other: {{count, number}} of {{total, number}} met their weekly goal
week.lede: The circle's goal is everyone meeting their own week. Each counts in their own time zone, and weeks start on Monday.

circle.name: Name
circle.cheers_one: {{count, number}} cheer in the last day
circle.cheers_other: {{count, number}} cheers in the last day

invite.title: Invite a friend
invite.lede: Send this link to a friend with an AnyLearn account. Anyone with the link can join until the owner makes a new code.

manage.title: Manage the circle
manage.newCodeNote: The old link stops working; members stay.

leave.title: Leave the circle
leave.last: You are its only member: leaving deletes the circle.
leave.owner: You started it: the member who joined next becomes its owner.
leave.member: The others will no longer see your progress.

done.invite: A new code is ready; the old link no longer works.
